upstream.description: Local voice AI powered by llama-cpp, Kokoro, Nemotron STT, and LiveKit.

classification.analysis: A self-hosted, real-time local voice AI assistant that runs STT, LLM, and TTS entirely in one Docker container, supervised by a single Python parent process: llama.cpp (default Gemma model) for the LLM, Nemotron or faster-whisper for speech-to-text, Kokoro for text-to-speech, and LiveKit Agents/WebRTC for the real-time pipeline, fronted by a Next.js frontend. Any component can be swapped for a cloud provider (OpenAI, LiveKit Cloud, remote STT/TTS) via a base-URL environment variable. Aimed at developers who want a private, offline-capable voice assistant runnable on a single machine, with documented GPU (NVIDIA) and Apple Silicon (Metal) paths.

use_cases.title: Run a fully local, private real-time voice assistant
Prototype a LiveKit-based voice agent with swappable providers
